styles.name: penrose-p3
styles.description: Penrose P3 rhombus tiling built by Robinson-triangle subdivision: fat (72°) rhombs in outline, thin (36°) rhombs stippled, laid left to right across the strip as the tiling slowly drifts

styles.name: penrose-p2
styles.description: Penrose P2 kite & dart tiling built by Robinson-triangle subdivision: kites in outline, darts stippled, laid left to right across the strip as the tiling slowly drifts

styles.name: sun-pattern
styles.description: Penrose sun: five kites (72-72-72-144°) meeting tip-to-tip at one vertex, laid kite by kite and slowly turning between two progress paths

styles.name: girih-tiles
styles.description: Islamic girih frieze: a row of edge-sharing decagon tiles, each carrying the ten-pointed strapwork star whose points touch every tile edge at its midpoint, meeting the neighbouring star there; tiles are laid left to right with progress and a spark runs round each finished star

styles.name: ammann-bars
styles.description: Ammann bars: the five families of parallel bars that run through every Penrose rhomb tiling, at 72° to one another, each spaced in the never-repeating Fibonacci order of long and short gaps (L/S = φ); a faint rhomb tiling lies beneath, and the families sweep in one after another with progress, sliding slowly with time

styles.name: debruijn-pentagrid
styles.description: de Bruijn pentagrid: five families of evenly spaced parallel lines at 72° to one another, each with its own offset, whose dual is a Penrose tiling; the families are laid one after another across the strip with progress and the grid drifts slowly with time

styles.name: decagon-fractal
styles.description: Decagon fractal: a frieze of self-similar decagons — each holds a ring of ten satellites and a 1/φ²-scaled copy of itself at its heart, which repeats the rule; flakes unfold left to right with progress, rings counter-turning

styles.name: quasicrystal-diffraction
styles.description: Quasicrystal diffraction: a row of 10-fold Bragg-spot patterns (bright centre, two rings of ten spots at radii in φ ratio, the outer ring turned 18°) — the forbidden symmetry that won Shechtman the Nobel prize; patterns expose left to right with progress and their spots twinkle

styles.name: pinwheel-tiling
styles.description: Pinwheel tiling: a 1:2 right triangle substitutes into 5 smaller copies at irrational rotations, filling the plane with triangles at every angle; deflation generations bloom outward as progress rises

styles.name: truchet-quasi
styles.description: Truchet-quasi: Truchet-style arcs on a Penrose rhomb tiling — every tile carries an arc round its corner, and the arcs join across tile edges into unbroken curves that never repeat; tiles are laid left to right with progress, edges faint, and the tiling drifts slowly with time
